title: Google's First Name Was BackRub, Not Google
description:
Google's first name was BackRub, a 1996 Stanford project that ranked web pages by their backlinks.
Follow MarketOpsTips for the stories behind big brands.

#business #google #shorts

beats.say: Before it was called Google, the search engine had a strange name: BackRub.
In 1996, it was a project at Stanford University.
It was built by Larry Page and Sergey Brin.
They called it BackRub because it ranked pages by their backlinks.
Later they renamed it Google, from the word googol.
A googol is a 1 followed by 100 zeros.
Would you have searched on BackRub?
